plugins.name: skillz
plugins.description: A growing bundle of personal Claude Code skills. Currently: croc (the default for sending — peer-to-peer end-to-end-encrypted file/text transfer to any computer via a code phrase, no SSH needed), file-transfer (the SSH specialist, for what croc can't do: unattended push to a passwordless-SSH host like the macminim Mac mini, plus pull and ls, over rsync), claude-ai-archive (import/sync a claude.ai data export into a local on-disk mirror), sprite (Sprite VM environment agent), sprite-api-gateway (authenticated external API access from a Sprite), test-on-sprite (test a repo in a disposable Sprite VM via herdr panes), herdr (modified fork of herdr's AGPL-3.0 agent skill with corrected pane self-identification), reflex (standing "whenever X, do Y" instructions that fire on their own in later sessions, kept as plain markdown imported by CLAUDE.md), whetstone (adversarial cross-agent review loop: PR, Codex review, fix every finding, repeat until a round returns clean, then merge), grilling (interview the user relentlessly about a plan or decision via round-by-round design-tree questioning; imported unmodified from mattpocock/skills, MIT), and living-docs (keep a repo's living documents in the root and retire superseded ones into history/ — one accepted version per doc, drafts beside it, nothing deleted).
